summary: Muhammad Abuzar came into the session fatigued from a high-pressure week of late nights working toward a product deadline. The central focus was his promotion conversation with his manager, which he had fully prepared for but ultimately postponed at the last moment.
keyThemes: Promotion conversation avoidance despite full preparation
Work fatigue and its impact on confidence
insights: Muhammad had all the material ready yet still chose to reschedule — the blocker is emotional, not logistical.

actionItems.text: Schedule and actually have the promotion conversation with your manager this week.

coachActionItems.text: Focus next session on psychological hesitation, not tactical preparation.

coachObservations: Confidence and self-worth issue, not a preparation issue.
